question: If two sources deal damage at the same time to a Sliver that has absorb 1, is 1 damage prevented from each source?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: absorb prevents 1 damage from each of the sources.
expected.answer: If multiple sources would deal damage to a Sliver at once, prevent 1 damage from each of those sources.
